population: the same 18 unique development records as RK-12; no untouched24 or functional untouched

primary_effects.direction: LinearDesign-11 minus comparator; positive means higher normalized hypervolume
LinearDesign-11 minus comparator; positive means higher diversity, not better functional performance

statistics.ci_method: percentile paired bootstrap over record indices
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over 12 primary comparisons: six comparators x two metrics
statistics.p_value: two-sided sign-tail bootstrap p with plus-one correction, capped at 1
statistics.selection: reference, comparators, metrics and correction frozen before EnsembleDesign generation; no per-record oracle comparator

cost.lineardesign: sum of 11 measured single-worker official-process wall clocks per record; inherited from the frozen RK-12 grid
cost.ensembledesign: one measured official-process wall clock per record with four internal threads, including 11 runs and internal EFE scoring
cost.other_methods: legacy fields retained; no uniform hardware/parallelism/end-to-end cost is inferred

decision_boundary: development seven-method actual-output comparison only; descriptive method ranking and paired effects do not establish CodonFlow-RK improvement, dense AUC, unified time-matched cost, functional OOD or SOTA
